about: Seeded defects for tools/mutation-lab.html. Each entry is an exact string replacement applied to game.html. 'find' must occur exactly once in the file and must land in the production half, before the line 'const TESTS = ['. A mutation stays in this file after its hole is fixed - removing a mutation once the suite learned to catch it would make the next kill rate a lie.

mutations.breaks: LITO stands on the only square from which PapaFoxx's bed can be reached, so recruiting him becomes impossible once LITO joins
RETROLISTIC is drawn standing inside the inn's solid stew pot
leaving the Armory puts the player inside the village's solid loot barrel
jacking out of the internet lands the player on top of KID BIT
the Wire's signpost sits on blank floor: nothing is drawn and the node beside it takes the turn first
the arrival scene for the whole internet act never fires when you walk through the gateway
the credits quote a battle count that disagrees with every other figure in the game

mutations.find: so it is true by construction: it shows the test bites
mutations.replace: so it shows the test bites
mutations.breaks: a flip-test figure a player reads loses the limit that makes it honest

mutations.find: On the bench it used 0.61x the tokens
mutations.replace: On the bench it used 0.51x the tokens
mutations.breaks: a teaching module quotes a token ratio the cited repo does not report
the Cleric merge gives a high-level sheet a low-level XP total, freezing the bar at zero
reawakening count collapses to a boolean and renders as a word instead of a number
a save from another schema version loads without migration
the list of deleted souls empties, so nothing stops the retired Cleric being seated again
late-game rooms seat more bodies than every published balance campaign measured
the Firewall Bastion loses its authored density and goes back over the wipe ceiling
the Load Balancer Rig gives less cover than its own description promises
an attack can land for zero, so a debuffed party can be unable to hurt anything at all
PapaFoxx, a caster, joins in the front row and takes melee damage he was never meant to
every character crits two thirds more often, which moves every balance number in the game
the combo bonus pays more at the top step than the design allows

mutations.find: function incoming(raw, a, extraRed){ let d=Math.max(0, raw
mutations.replace: function incoming(raw, a, extraRed){ let d=Math.max(-2, raw
mutations.breaks: damage can go negative, so a well-armoured ally is HEALED by being hit
defending cuts damage by a third instead of a half
the back row loses two attack in melee instead of one
any enemy without an explicit speed acts before the entire party
the fallback row rule forgets the casters, so a sheet without a stored row puts them in melee
the cheapest consumable heals almost twice what its own text promises
a heal is no longer clamped, so an ally can be pushed above their own maximum HP
the XP bar is no longer clamped and can render past its own ends
every resource node pays double, which is the whole crafting economy
hitting a level threshold exactly no longer levels you up
loot barrels stop being solid, so the player can walk through the scenery
the square you stand on is checked FIRST, so standing on a chest shadows every neighbour you meant to talk to
